note: A pack is one basin's assembled data: GloFAS forecast + historical runs plus the impact-record summary the workbench may show. EM-DAT records are NEVER included in a pack (EM-DAT prohibits redistribution); impact records in a pack are bring-your-own only. See PACKING.md for the pipeline.

data_sources.historical: cems-glofas-historical (ECMWF Early Warning Data Store), average_river_discharge_in_the_last_24_hours (consolidated, time_mean)
data_sources.impact_records: DesInventar Uganda record years by district/sub-county (public data, embedded as record years only)
data_sources.reforecast: cems-glofas-reforecast (ECMWF Early Warning Data Store), river_discharge_in_the_last_24_hours, 11 members, Mon/Thu inits, leads 24/96/168 h

files: data.js (embedded site data, generated from results.json by pull/make_data_js.py)
data/glofas/teso_v4/results.json (source of every number in data.js)
packs.licence_notes: CEMS-FLOODS data may be reproduced and redistributed with attribution to ECMWF / CEMS-Floods. EM-DAT data are NOT in this pack and must never be added to one: EM-DAT prohibits redistribution, so EM-DAT records are bring-your-own only (visitor uploads their own CSV in the browser; it never leaves their machine). DesInventar record years are public impact data.

sites.snap_rule: nearest grid box (paper's rule); ties by larger upstream area
